observation_profile.limitations: Collision is a digital pixel witness, not a framebuffer photo; source landing must be checked before attributing any difference to render delay.

observation_profile.measurement_fields: counter/ICR CLXDAT; irq_level/aux before/after collision read beams

repeatability.note: Zero conflicts does not establish cross-run repeatability when phase cohorts do not overlap.
